title: Add DevOps Agent with GitHub and Vercel integrations for autonomous development
body:
Enables AI-driven autonomous software development: agent reads ObjectStack specs, generates code, manages Git workflow, deploys to Vercel, and self-iterates on improvements.

## Core Components

### GitHub Connector (`src/integration/connector/github.zod.ts`)
- Repository management, branch protection, PR automation
- GitHub Actions workflow integration, release management
- Webhook support for real-time events

### Vercel Connector (`src/integration/connector/vercel.zod.ts`)
- Multi-region deployments with preview/production environments
- Edge functions, domain management, environment variables
- Monitoring integration (analytics, speed insights, log drains)

### DevOps Agent (`src/ai/devops-agent.zod.ts`)
- Code generation from ObjectStack specifications
- CI/CD pipeline orchestration (build, test, lint, security scan, deploy)
- Version management (semver, changelog generation)
- Deployment strategies (rolling, blue-green, canary) with auto-rollback
- Self-iteration capabilities for continuous optimization

## Usage

```typescript
import { DevOpsAgent, GitHubConnector, VercelConnector } from '@objectstack/spec';

const devopsAgent: DevOpsAgent = {
  name: 'enterprise_devops',
  role: 'Senior Full-Stack DevOps Engineer',
  
  developmentConfig: {
    specificationSource: 'packages/spec',
    codeGeneration: {
      targets: ['frontend', 'backend', 'api', 'tests'],
      validationMode: 'strict',
    },
  },
  
  integrations: {
    github: {
      connector: 'github_main',
      repository: { owner: 'org', name: 'app' },
      pullRequest: { autoCreate: true, requireReviews: true },
    },
    vercel: {
      connector: 'vercel_prod',
      project: 'app',
      deployment: { requireApproval: true },
    },
  },
  
  selfIteration: {
    enabled: true,
    optimizationGoals: ['code_quality', 'performance', 'security'],
  },
};
```

The agent autonomously handles: spec → code → tests → PR → CI → review → merge → deploy → monitor → optimize.

## Schema Structure

All schemas follow Zod-first pattern with full TypeScript inference. Naming: `camelCase` for configuration properties, `snake_case` for identifiers.

See `examples/devops-agent-example.ts` for production configuration.
